privacy.title: Privacy Policy – Intranet
privacy.subtitle: How we process personal data of authorized Advantis employees within the intranet – in line with the GDPR

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: This privacy policy applies exclusively to individuals who have been authorized for the advantis GmbH intranet (“Intranet”) and hold an active, provisioned account (“users”). It supplements the general privacy policy at advantisgroup.de with the additional processing that takes place solely within the Intranet.

Anyone who merely registers or attempts to sign in through our authentication provider without being provisioned for the Intranet does not thereby become a user under this policy. Such sign-up attempts are covered exclusively by the “Unauthorized access attempts” section below – the remaining provisions of this policy, as well as the Intranet's Terms of Use, never apply to them.
Access to the Intranet is only granted after the email domain is checked or after explicit approval by a manager or administrator (see the Terms of Use, “Access and authorization”).

sections.title: Controller
paragraphs: The controller responsible for data processing within the Intranet is:

sections.title: What data we process, and why
paragraphs: In connection with using the Intranet, we process the following categories of personal data of authorized users:

list.title: Account and profile data
list.description: Name, business email address, role, department, job title, phone number and profile picture – for identification, internal organization and permission management (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

list.title: Sign-in and security data
list.description: Sign-in events and session data processed by our identity provider – to secure access (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

list.title: Usage and activity data for evaluation purposes
list.description: Presence and availability status derived from the interplay of the desktop agent, telephony (Genesys) and time tracking (Clockodo) – used to evaluate work performance, availability and capacity planning within the employment relationship (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR and, where applicable, § 26 BDSG).

list.title: Absence and calendar data
list.description: Vacation, sick leave and scheduling data – for staff planning (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

list.title: Communication and content data
list.description: Chat messages, announcements, reactions and uploaded files – for internal collaboration (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR).

list.title: Log and audit data
list.description: Administrative actions such as permission grants or status changes – for accountability and IT security (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

list.title: Technical access data
list.description: IP address, browser and device type, and timestamps – to operate the platform securely (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.note: We do not process special categories of personal data (Art. 9 GDPR) within the Intranet unless users actively and voluntarily share such data themselves, for example as part of a sick-leave absence.

sections.title: Recipients and processors
paragraphs: To provide the Intranet, we rely on carefully selected service providers who act as processors under Art. 28 GDPR on our behalf, or to whom we disclose data to fulfil the employment relationship:

list.title: Identity provider
list.description: Authentication and account management.

list.title: Database and backend provider
list.description: Database and backend infrastructure for the Intranet.

list.title: Hosting provider
list.description: Application hosting.

list.title: Email delivery provider
list.description: Transactional email delivery, e.g. invitations and status notifications.

list.title: Microsoft OneDrive
list.description: Storage and sharing of internal documents.

list.title: Genesys Cloud
list.description: Telephony presence data for availability evaluation.

list.title: Clockodo
list.description: Time-tracking data for availability evaluation.

sections.note: Where individual providers process data outside the EU/EEA, we ensure an adequate level of data protection through appropriate safeguards, in particular EU Standard Contractual Clauses. We do not disclose data to other third parties unless legally required to do so.

sections.title: Retention period
paragraphs: We store personal data only for as long as necessary for the respective purpose, or as required by statutory retention obligations, such as commercial and tax-law periods of up to ten years.

Account and profile data is stored for the duration of the provisioned access. If access is revoked, not granted, or an access request is denied, we delete the associated account, including profile data; business records that already exist and are subject to a statutory retention obligation are unaffected and are retained in pseudonymized form.
Attendance and availability evaluation data is retained only for as long as necessary for the respective evaluation period.

sections.title: Unauthorized access attempts
paragraphs: Registration is technically open, but authorization is only checked after sign-in, based on the email domain and any invitation on file. As a result, an account can be created even though there is no authorization for the Intranet.

In that case, the affected person is shown that access has been denied (“Access denied”) and the account created with our identity provider is deleted automatically and without delay. We do not further process the data submitted during that sign-up attempt, such as name and email address. This privacy policy and the Intranet's Terms of Use never take effect for such persons.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Authorized users have the following rights regarding their personal data at any time:

list.title: Access
list.description: Request information about the data we process about you (Art. 15 GDPR).

list.title: Rectification
list.description: Request correction of inaccurate data (Art. 16 GDPR).

list.title: Erasure
list.description: Request deletion of your data, unless a retention obligation applies (Art. 17 GDPR).

list.title: Restriction
list.description: Request restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR).

list.title: Objection
list.description: Object to processing based on a legitimate interest (Art. 21 GDPR).

list.title: Data portability
list.description: Receive your data in a structured, commonly used format (Art. 20 GDPR).

sections.note: To exercise these rights, an informal message to the email address given above is sufficient. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority; the authority responsible for us is the Bavarian State Office for Data Protection Supervision (BayLDA).

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We protect the data processed within the Intranet through technical and organizational measures, including encrypted transmission (TLS), role-based access rights, and logging of security-relevant administrative actions.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We update this privacy policy whenever data processing within the Intranet changes. The current version is always available on this page.

terms.title: Terms of Use – Intranet
terms.subtitle: Terms governing the use of the Advantis Group intranet by authorized employees

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: These Terms of Use apply exclusively to individuals to whom advantis GmbH has expressly granted access to the Intranet and whose account is actively provisioned (“users”).

Merely creating an account or attempting to sign in does not create any entitlement to access and does not make these Terms of Use applicable. Individuals without authorization instead receive a notice that access has been denied, and their account is deleted automatically (see the Privacy Policy, “Unauthorized access attempts”).

sections.title: Access and authorization
paragraphs: Access to the Intranet is granted exclusively to individuals with an active business relationship with advantis GmbH whose business email address belongs to an approved company domain, or who have received an explicit invitation or approval from a manager or administrator.

Access requests are reviewed by managers or administrators and may be declined. Sign-up attempts using email domains that are not approved are automatically denied, and the account created in the process is deleted without delay.
Users must keep their access credentials confidential and must not share them with third parties.

sections.title: Intended use
paragraphs: The Intranet serves exclusively internal business purposes of advantis GmbH, in particular communication, scheduling, absence management, storage of internal documents, and team collaboration.
Content, documents and information accessible through the Intranet are confidential and must not be shared with third parties outside the company without consent.
Private or commercial use unrelated to the employment relationship is not permitted.

sections.title: Notice regarding evaluation of usage data
paragraphs: In connection with using the Intranet, certain usage, attendance and availability data is processed for evaluation purposes, as described in detail in the Privacy Policy.
By using the Intranet, users acknowledge that this processing takes place within the context of their existing employment relationship.

sections.title: User obligations
paragraphs: Users agree to

list.description: keep their account and profile data up to date,
comply with advantis GmbH's applicable IT and security policies,
maintain a respectful tone in internal chat and announcements,
report security-relevant incidents, such as suspected unauthorized access, without delay.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: The Intranet is provided as an internal work tool “as is.” advantis GmbH may modify, restrict or discontinue features at any time and does not guarantee uninterrupted availability.

sections.title: Suspension and termination of access
paragraphs: Access may be restricted, suspended or terminated at any time, in particular upon termination of the employment relationship, a violation of these Terms of Use, or for security reasons.
Upon termination of access, the account is deleted or anonymized in accordance with the Privacy Policy; statutory retention obligations remain unaffected.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: All content, documents, templates and materials made available through the Intranet are the property of advantis GmbH or its licensors and may be used solely for internal purposes.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: advantis GmbH is liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence, and in accordance with the Product Liability Act. Beyond that, it is liable only for breach of material contractual obligations and limited to foreseeable damage typical for this type of contract. Liability for damages arising from injury to life, body or health remains unaffected.

sections.title: Changes to these Terms of Use
paragraphs: We may amend these Terms of Use with effect for the future, for example when the systems we use change. We will inform users of material changes in an appropriate manner.

sections.title: Governing law and jurisdiction
paragraphs: These Terms of Use are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. To the extent legally permissible, the place of jurisdiction is Nuremberg.

Applicants.noSelectableText: This page has no selectable text (likely a scan) – the details must be entered manually.
Applicants.pdfLoadFailed: The PDF preview couldn't be loaded. You can still enter the details manually.
Applicants.duplicateFoundDescription: "{name}" matches an existing applicant record on {field}. Should the PDF be added to the existing file, or should a new applicant be created anyway?
Applicants.poolEmpty: The applicant pool is empty. Log a first contact for a new applicant to move them here.
Applicants.neuEmpty: No new applicants yet. Upload a CV as PDF to get started.
Applicants.profilesDescription: One skill profile per position – shows in the applicant file how many skills are covered.
Applicants.noProfiles: No skill profiles yet. Create a position first, then add its skills.
Applicants.noSkillsYet: No skills in this profile yet.
Applicants.noMatches: No applicant currently matches any skill in this profile.
Applicants.deleteProfileConfirm: Delete the skill profile "{name}"? Applicants using it will no longer show a match.
Applicants.calendarDescription: Appointments for the next 4 weeks – created here or in the applicant file, they show up in both places. After the appointment: convert it to a contact entry with one click.
Applicants.noApplicantsYet: No applicants yet — appointments are always linked to one.
Applicants.terminSaved: Appointment saved — it now appears on the calendar and on the applicant's file.
Applicants.wiedervorlageHint: Follow-up: date was set to {date} (3 workdays out) — adjust individually if needed.
Applicants.pastTermineWithoutContact: Past appointments without a logged contact ({count})
Applicants.accessDescription: Only people granted access here can see applicant data. Requirement: at least Manager, or a role with "Manage members".
Applicants.noEligibleUsers: No eligible users left to grant access to — they need to be at least Manager, or hold a custom role with Manage Members.
Applicants.eligibilityHint: Only users who are at least Manager, or hold a custom role with Manage Members, are shown here.
Applicants.noOneHasAccess: No one has been granted access yet.
Applicants.grantAccessDescription: {name} will be able to view and edit all applicant records.
Applicants.grantAccessItem1: Can view and edit all applicant records
Applicants.grantAccessItem2: Can log appointments, contacts, and interviews
Applicants.revokeAccessDescription: {name} will immediately lose access to all applicant data.
Applicants.revokeAccessItem1: Loses access to all applicant records immediately
Applicants.revokeAccessItem2: Existing records and history are kept, just no longer visible to them
Applicants.deleteApplicantConfirm: This permanently deletes {name}'s file, including all documents, contacts, emails, interviews, and appointments. Type the applicant's name to confirm.
Applicants.applicantNotFound: This applicant file could not be found.
Applicants.timelineEmpty: No activity yet – appointments, contacts, interviews and emails will appear here in chronological order.
Applicants.name: Name
Applicants.noProfilesYet: No skill profiles defined yet — create one per position under "Skill profiles".
Applicants.maxFileSizeHint: Max. 3.5 MB per file. Additional documents are stored but not re-read by AI.
Applicants.firstContactHint: Logging the first contact automatically moves this file from "New applicants" into the applicant pool.
Applicants.emailDoesNotCountHint: Email entries belong to this file only and don't count as a first contact — the file stays under "New applicants".
Applicants.interviewNotePlaceholder: Impression, answers, professional assessment, salary expectations…
